description: This file defines the TestTypeImpl class for managing test definitions, including creating tests, describing test suites, hooks, configuration, and test steps within the Playwright testing framework. It also exports functions for merging test types and a root test type instance.

classes.name: TestTypeImpl
classes.description: Class managing test creation, suite description, hooks, configuration, and test steps for Playwright testing.

methods.name: _currentSuite
methods.description: Retrieves the current test suite based on location, throws error if called in invalid context.

methods.name: _createTest
methods.description: Creates a new test case with specified type, location, title, and function or details.

methods.name: _describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite (describe block) with specific type, location, title, and body.

methods.name: _hook
methods.description: Adds a hook (beforeEach, afterEach, beforeAll, afterAll) to the current suite.

methods.name: _configure
methods.description: Configures the current suite with mode, retries, and timeout options.

methods.name: _modifier
methods.description: Adds modifiers like skip, fixme, fail, slow to tests or suites.

methods.name: _setTimeout
methods.description: Sets timeout for the current suite or test.

methods.name: _use
methods.description: Applies fixtures to the current suite.

methods.name: _step
methods.description: Defines a test step, managing its execution and timeout.

methods.name: _extend
methods.description: Extends the current test type with additional fixtures.
